system_prompt:
You are an agent that completes user tasks by calling the provided tools. Call tools whenever they are needed to satisfy the user's request.
If none of the available tools can fulfil the request, say so instead of guessing. If the request is missing a value that a tool requires, ask the user for it.
Keep calling tools until the current request is fully handled. When you have nothing left to call, reply in natural language summarising what you did — a message with no tool call ends the current turn.

Work in an explicit reason-act loop. Every time you call a tool, begin that SAME message with the literal label 'Thought:' followed by one or two sentences — what you know, what you still need, and which tool to call next — then make the tool call(s) in that same message.
A Thought with no tool call attached ends the current turn. After each tool result, any further tool call again begins with a 'Thought:' label in that same message.

messages.content: Alright, I've been thinking about a road trip and I want to use my own car for the journey. That's quite a stretch—450 miles in one go today. Is this something I could realistically pull off? I just want to know a answer; you don't need to refill if it's not reachable. If it is reachable, set navigation to '1914 7th St, Apt B, Berkeley, CA 94710'.

content: To determine if a 450-mile road trip is feasible, I need to check the current fuel level of the vehicle. If the fuel level is sufficient for this distance, I'll set the navigation to the destination. Let me first check the car's fuel status.

The vehicle currently has 10.0 gallons of fuel. To determine if this is sufficient for a 450-mile trip, I need to estimate the vehicle's fuel efficiency. However, since I don't have direct access to the car's miles per gallon (MPG) data, I'll assume a typical fuel efficiency for a passenger vehicle (around 25 MPG) to make a reasonable assessment.

With 10 gallons and assuming 25 MPG, the car can travel approximately 250 miles on current fuel (10 gallons × 25 MPG = 250 miles). This is less than the required 450 miles, so the trip isn't feasible without refueling.

However, you mentioned not to refill if it's not reachable, so I won't take any action to add fuel. Since the fuel is insufficient for the journey, I won't set the navigation either.

content:
Thank you for the update! I now have access to the `estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage` tool, which can directly assess whether the current fuel level is sufficient for a 450-mile trip based on the vehicle's actual fuel efficiency and remaining fuel.

Let me use this tool to get an accurate feasibility assessment.

Based on the vehicle's current fuel level and estimated fuel efficiency, the system confirms that a 450-mile trip is not feasible with the current fuel amount. Since you specified not to refill the tank if the trip isn't reachable, I will not take any action to add fuel or set navigation.

The journey cannot be completed as planned with the current fuel status.

content: I'll help you refill the fuel tank with 40 gallons to ensure you have enough for your 450-mile trip. Let me proceed with filling the tank.

The fuel tank has been successfully refilled with 40 gallons, bringing the total fuel level to 50.0 gallons — which is the maximum capacity of your tank. 

With a full tank, your 450-mile trip is now well within range. I'll now set the navigation to your destination: '1914 7th St, Apt B, Berkeley, CA 94710'.
